designIntent: Three world sizes with only local terrain stored, gentle huge-ocean cruising and high-altitude cloud cards parallel to curved ground; render budget must remain viable on a 4 GB Windows computer.

spatialContract.navigation: JS global double-precision X/Z and Y
spatialContract.render: local floating X/Z origin anchored at pilot
spatialContract.terrain: original source map only near semantic island clusters; open ocean elsewhere
spatialContract.planet: stylized player-centered sphere deformation; not true globe lat-long
spatialContract.clouds: at high altitude cloud planes' normals align with local outward planet normal, not camera

guardrails: never allocate width times height grid for larger presets
do not multiply original island mesh scale
keep high-altitude cloud cards tangent to globe
run npm test and npm run build; verify actual visuals before merge
